name: merecatholicity
description: Build tooling for merecatholicity.com — the static site (docs/) and its Cloudflare Workers. Not a published package; it manages the whole front-end toolchain behind a committed lockfile: Tailwind, esbuild, TypeScript, wrangler, spago (the PureScript compiler itself comes by pinned hash: scripts/toolchain.py), and Lit (the app's UI library, bundled into app.js); tweetnacl, lamejs and qrcode-generator are copied into docs/ as standalone scripts by scripts/vendor.ts.

scripts.build:ps: python3 scripts/writings.py && rm -rf purescript/output && cd purescript && PATH="$PWD/../local/bin:$PATH" spago build
scripts.build:js: npm run build:ps && rm -rf docs/chunks && esbuild app/app.ts app/chrome.ts --bundle --format=esm --splitting --minify --outdir=docs --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=chunks/[name]-[hash] --log-level=warning && npm run build:pagejs && npm run build:vendor && npm run build:client
scripts.tsc: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p pagejs/tsconfig.sw.json && tsc -p comments-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p contact-worker/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run tsc && npm run build:css
scripts.build:pagejs: esbuild pagejs/nav.ts pagejs/deeplink.ts pagejs/flash.ts pagejs/contact.ts pagejs/bible-reader.ts pagejs/away.ts pagejs/index.ts --minify --outdir=docs --tsconfig-raw={} --log-level=warning && esbuild pagejs/sw.ts --outfile=docs/sw.js --tsconfig-raw={} --log-level=warning
